d:
This is the start of me working through the Surio Anubis mainline of works, including the FBI one, because how couldn't I? The JP scans have been up for a good while, but if the uncensoreds are available now, why not hit those up?
The why would be because it makes file and TL management an absolute bitch when the versions are slightly different pretty consistently visually, and requires re-adding in bubbles, splicing visuals, and just a host of other troubles that lead to this being a Frankenstein monster of a project. The things I won't do for porn.

Massive thanks to Crimson for holding out on these CN scans so I don't get sniped by the shitters that infest this site, and to Luna for letting us bug him constantly about CN differences and management, and to slazer for letting me hit him up for random bits and bobs.

Also yes, we're doing the rest and more, I love Surio.
